summary: Build practical data product ownership, contract, SLA, and risk governance skills. Review the five-day course and curriculum.
lede: Data product and data mesh governance training helps data leaders, domain owners, governance managers, and risk professionals define accountable data products. It covers mapping ownership and decision rights, assessing product readiness, drafting data contracts and service-level measures, and linking product risks to privacy, security, and compliance controls. Participants also practise setting quality measures and preparing an executive scorecard.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who set data product accountabilities, oversee federated governance, or connect data architecture decisions with business risk and compliance.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with data governance, data management, or enterprise data initiatives will help you contribute to the case exercises. No coding or data-platform configuration is required; the course focuses on operating models, governance decisions, roles, service levels, and risk integration.
